---

### 🗓️ Terms Especially Characteristic of This Period

Several terms stand out as highly specific to this particular week, reflecting the major news events and conversations of early January 2025:

#### 🇺🇸 US Politics & Jan 6 Anniversary (Jan 6 fell on Day 6)
- **`insurrect`** (2,242) / **`insurrectionist`** (1,782) / **`capitol`** (1,640) — The 4th anniversary of January 6th drove heavy discussion.
- **`amend`** (2,834) — Constitutional amendment debates were prominent.
- **`felon`** (4,033) / **`traitor`** (2,156) / **`rapist`** (1,758) — Charged political language directed at Trump.
- **`garland`** (3,476) / **`harri`** (3,142) — Merrick Garland and Kamala Harris featured heavily.
- **`inaugur`** (2,173) — Anticipation of Trump's upcoming inauguration.
- **`fascist`** (1,878) / **`fascism`** (1,719) — Heightened political rhetoric.
- **`democraci`** (7,594) — Democracy concerns were a top theme.
- **`gop`** (4,306) / **`billionair`** (4,742) / **`oligarch`** (1,523) — Class and power critiques.

#### 🌍 Geopolitical Flashpoints
- **`canada`** (5,205) / **`trudeau`** (995) / **`greenland`** (2,836) — Trump's provocative statements about annexing Canada and Greenland dominated Jan 6–7.
- **`russia`** (3,394) / **`putin`** (3,907) / **`ukrain`** (2,533) — Ongoing Ukraine war coverage.
- **`israel`** (2,261) / **`genocid`** (1,590) / **`gaza`** (1,512) — Continued Israel-Gaza conflict discussion.

#### 🏏 Sports & Culture
- **`ausvind`** / **`cricket`** / **`bumrah`** / **`boland`** — The Australia vs. India Test cricket series (SCG Test) was a major topic Jan 3–5.
- **`goldenglob`** / **`film`** / **`award`** — The Golden Globes ceremony on Jan 6 generated significant buzz.
- **`trudeau`** / **`poilievr`** — Canadian political leadership crisis (Trudeau's resignation announcement).

#### 📚 Recurring Community Topics
- **`book`** / **`bookski`** / **`novel`** / **`read`** — A persistent Bluesky book-reading community was active all week.
- **`vaccin`** (2,129) / **`covid`** (2,796) / **`rfk`** — Health and vaccine debates, likely tied to RFK Jr.'s nomination.
- **`bot`** (2,588) / **`blueski`** (3,815) / **`platform`** (3,496) — Meta-discussion about Bluesky itself and platform moderation.
